relations.name: defines
relations.description: Subject explicitly defines, describes, or establishes the meaning of the object.

relations.name: requires
relations.description: Subject mandates, requires, or makes the object necessary.

relations.name: authorizes
relations.description: Subject grants authority, permission, or responsibility to the object.

relations.name: prohibits
relations.description: Subject explicitly forbids or restricts the object.

relations.name: recommends
relations.description: Subject recommends or advises the object without making it mandatory.

relations.name: treats
relations.description: Subject intervention or procedure treats the object condition or injury.

relations.name: prevents
relations.description: Subject prevents, reduces risk of, or protects against the object.

relations.name: indicates
relations.description: Subject sign, symptom, or finding indicates the object condition or next action.

relations.name: part_of
relations.description: Subject is a component, phase, section, or step of the object.

relations.name: applies_to
relations.description: Subject applies to the object audience, condition, role, unit, or situation.

relations.name: uses
relations.description: Subject procedure, role, or system uses the object equipment, method, or resource.

relations.name: reports_to
relations.description: Subject organization, office, or role reports to the object.

relations.name: responsible_for
relations.description: Subject organization, office, or role is responsible for the object.

relations.name: supports
relations.description: Subject supports, enables, or provides evidence for the object.

relations.name: supersedes
relations.description: Subject replaces, rescinds, or supersedes the object.

relations.name: documented_in
relations.description: Provenance-only document location relation; do not emit as a semantic graph assertion.
